question: What do you say when you wake up in the morning? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! We say Good morning when the sun comes up! ☀️
hint: The sun is shining bright!

question: What do you say when someone gives you a toy? 🧸
explanation: Yay! We always say Thank you when we get a gift! 🎉
hint: It is a magic word for receiving things.

question: What do you say when you make a mistake? 🥺
explanation: Super star! Saying Sorry makes everything better! ❤️
hint: You say this when you do something wrong.

question: What do you say when you want a pencil? ✏️
explanation: Great job! Please is a magic word we use to ask for things! ✨
hint: It starts with the letter P.

question: What do you say when you sneeze? 🤧
explanation: Awesome! We say Excuse me when we sneeze or cough! 🌟
hint: It is polite to say this after a sneeze.

question: What do you say before going to sleep? 😴
explanation: Yay! We wish our family Good night before we sleep! 🛌
hint: The moon and stars are out.

question: What do you say when you meet a friend? 👋
explanation: Super star! We say Hello to greet our friends! 🎉
hint: You smile and wave your hand.

question: What do you say when you leave for school? 🎒
explanation: Great job! We wave and say Bye bye when we go! 🚶
hint: You say this when you are going away.

question: What do you say when the sun goes down? 🌇
explanation: Awesome! We say Good evening when it is time to play! ⚽
hint: It is the time before night.

question: What do you say when you eat lunch at noon? 🍱
explanation: Yay! We say Good afternoon in the middle of the day! 🥪
hint: The sun is very high in the sky.

question: What do you say when Mother gives you milk? 🥛
explanation: Super star! We thank our mother for the yummy milk! 😋
hint: It is the magic word for getting something.

question: What do you say if you break a glass? 🥛🔨
explanation: Great job! Saying Sorry shows you will be careful next time! 🌟
hint: It is a magic word for a mistake.

question: What do you say to ask for an apple? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Saying Please is the nicest way to ask! ❤️
hint: It is a polite magic word.

question: What do you say if you cough? 😷
explanation: Yay! We cover our mouth and say Excuse me! ✨
hint: You use it just like when you sneeze.

question: What do you say to your teacher in the morning? 👩‍🏫
explanation: Super star! We always wish our teacher Good morning! 🏫
hint: You say this when school starts.

question: What do you see in the sky when you say Good night? 🌌
explanation: Great job! The moon comes out at night! 🌟
hint: It shines in the dark sky.

question: What do you say when Father gives you a hug? 🤗
explanation: Awesome! Hugs are nice gifts, so we say Thank you! ❤️
hint: It shows you are happy.

question: What do you say if you step on your friend's toe? 🦶
explanation: Yay! Saying Sorry makes your friend feel better! 🩹
hint: You say this when someone gets hurt.

question: What do you say to ask for water? 💧
explanation: Super star! 'Please give me water' is a very nice way to ask! 🥤
hint: It is a magic word to ask nicely.

question: What do you say when you yawn? 🥱
explanation: Great job! We cover our mouth and say Excuse me! 🌟
hint: You say this when you are sleepy and open your mouth.

question: What do you say when you arrive at the park? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! We say Hello to all our friends at the park! 🎈
hint: You wave your hand to greet them.

question: What do you say when you go home from the park? 🏠
explanation: Yay! We wave Bye bye when it is time to leave! 🚶
hint: You say this when leaving.

question: When the birds sing in the sky, we say...? 🐦
explanation: Super star! Birds sing happily in the early morning! 🎶
hint: It is the start of the day.

question: When you put on your pajamas, you say...? 👕
explanation: Great job! We wear pajamas to sleep tight at night! 🛌
hint: It is time for bed.

question: What do you say when Grandmother tells a story? 📖
explanation: Awesome! We thank our Grandma for the fun stories! 👵
hint: It shows you liked the story.

question: What do you say if you spill your water? 💧🌊
explanation: Yay! Saying Sorry helps fix the mistake! 🧽
hint: You say this for a mistake.

question: What do you say to borrow a book? 📘
explanation: Super star! Always use Please when you want to borrow something! ✨
hint: It is a polite asking word.

question: What do you say to walk past someone? 🚶‍♂️

hint: You say this to get some room.

question: When you eat your school tiffin, it is...? 🍱

hint: It is the middle of the day.

question: What do you say when a friend finds your lost toy? 🚗

question: What do you say if you forget your notebook? 📓

question: What do you say to join a game? 🎲

hint: It is a magic asking word.

question: When you brush your teeth after waking up, you say...? 🪥

question: What do you say when teacher gives you a star? ⭐
